Settings.Title: Anchor Settings
Settings.ThemeDesc: Choose a light or dark look, or follow your Windows setting.
Settings.LanguageDesc: The language Anchor's own windows and menus use. Restart to apply it everywhere.
Settings.RestartPrompt: Restart Anchor to finish switching language.
Settings.HotkeyDesc: A system-wide shortcut that brings the dock to the front — including when it's tucked behind a screen edge.
Hotkey.Taken: Another app is already using that shortcut. Try a different combination.
Hotkey.NeedModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or the Windows key to the combination.
Settings.PositionDesc: Float freely, or snap flush to a screen edge.
Settings.TransposeDesc: When the dock is snapped to the left or right edge, stack its icons vertically. Top, bottom and floating stay horizontal.
Settings.AutoHideDesc: Slide behind the edge and reveal on hover. A notch marks where it is.
Settings.AlwaysOnTopDesc: Keep the dock above other windows while it's floating. (When snapped it's always on top.)
Settings.StartupDesc: Launch Anchor automatically when you sign in.
Settings.ResetSectionDesc: Remove every pinned item and restore the seeded dock.
Reset.Title: Reset dock to defaults?
Reset.Body: This removes every pinned app, file, folder and link you've added, and restores the built-in defaults. This can't be undone.
Apps.Hint: Turn an item off to hide it from the dock without deleting it.
Apps.Empty: No items yet. Use “Add new” to add an app, file, folder or link.
About.Tagline: A floating dock for Windows 11, built with WinUI 3.
About.Credits: Developed by ajaykontham. Anchor is free and open source under the MIT License, and bug reports and feature requests are welcome on GitHub.
About.PrivacyDesc: What Anchor does and doesn't do with your data.
About.PrivacyLocalBody: Your dock items, layout and settings are saved locally to %AppData%\Anchor and never leave your device.
About.PrivacyIconsBody: App, file and folder icons come from Windows. For a web link, Anchor fetches the website's icon (favicon) over the internet — first directly from the site, and only if that fails, from DuckDuckGo's icon service, which receives just the site's domain. Downloaded icons are cached under %AppData%\Anchor\IconCache.
About.PrivacyTrackingBody: No accounts, no telemetry, no analytics, no ads. Launching an item hands it to Windows exactly as double-clicking it in Explorer would.
Add.Title: Add to Dock
Add.Subtitle: Add an app, file, folder, link or shortcut.
Add.App.Label: Application
Add.App.Hint: Pick an application to launch. Shortcuts (.lnk) are resolved automatically.
Add.File.Label: File
Add.File.Hint: Any file — it opens with its default app.
Add.Folder.Label: Folder
Add.Folder.Hint: Opens the folder in File Explorer.
Add.Link.Label: Web address
Add.Link.Hint: Opens in your default browser. https:// is added if you omit it.
Add.Shortcut.Label: Target or command
Add.Shortcut.Hint: Any path, URI or shell command. The type is detected automatically.
Add.Error.NoTarget: Enter or choose a target first.
Add.Error.BadUrl: Enter a valid web address, e.g. https://example.com. For other URIs or commands, use the Shortcut type.
